attempts.summary: Configured /etc/logrotate.d/inventory on node1 to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, keep 7 compressed rotations, and use copytruncate so the writer keeps appending to the same file post-rotation. Verified via a forced rotation (produced app.log.1.gz, truncated app.log to 0 bytes, confirmed continued writes land in the fresh file). Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via systemd, confirmed connection drop/reconnect, verified boot_id changed post-restart, and re-verified the logrotate config, compressed rotation archive, and live write capability all survived the restart.
